summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Payment Operations Audit System. Backend APIs mostly functional with one critical workflow enforcement issue. Frontend UI working correctly with full workflow validation.

critical_bugs.issue: Workflow enforcement not working correctly - allows audit closure even when requirements aren't met
critical_bugs.impact: Critical - bypasses business rules and allows invalid audit closures

passed_tests: Incident list displays all 20 seeded incidents correctly
View Audit button creates/fetches audit case for incident
Audit detail page shows all required sections (incident details, audit info, checklist, findings, actions, closure)
Checklist items can be updated via dropdown (response selection works)
New findings can be added with category, description, severity, and evidence
Action items can be added for findings with owner team and due date
Action status can be updated (open, in_progress, completed)
Frontend workflow enforcement works correctly - Close Audit button disabled until requirements met
Can successfully close audit when all requirements are satisfied
All CRUD operations for incidents, audits, checklist, findings, actions work
UI responsiveness and user experience is good
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical backend workflow enforcement bug in /api/close-audit endpoint - currently allows closure without validating all requirements are met. The frontend correctly enforces workflow rules, but backend validation is bypassed.
success_percentage: Backend: 92% (11/12 tests passed), Frontend: 100% (all UI workflows working)
